description: Python script that runs 'gn help' commands, parses the output, and generates HTML documentation for GN commands and subcommands.

methods.name: GetOutput
methods.description: Executes a command with arguments and returns its output, handling errors by returning an empty string.

methods.name: ParseTopLevel
methods.description: Parses the top-level help output into commands and HTML-formatted list items.

methods.name: ParseCommand
methods.description: Parses individual command help output into HTML sections, including examples and subsections.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates the help command execution, parsing, and HTML output generation.
